description: The one Vocab window. Rust opens it on Vocab's AppData root, whose settings.md the page reads (openAppData from @epicenter/folder/tauri, which finds it with Tauri's path API) and whose connections.md lists the endpoints the learner connected; the page then opens its data folder by path (openDataFolder): the folder settings.md names, or ~/Epicenter/<productName> (the app's name, core:app:allow-name), which Rust allows in Tauri's runtime file-system scope at startup. Any other folder opens only once the native picker (dialog:allow-open) allowed it; persisted-scope keeps that across launches. No capability names a folder. Through the folder plugin it may ask Epicenter to sync the data folder (epicenter://init) and whether Epicenter already does. It signs in with Epicenter for hosted tutor models and dictation and sends the account's requests with a token it never holds, and keeps its connected endpoints' keys in the keychain.
